subject: Showcase films: own-voice videos in each tab and a films page
description: The 16 IMINT showcase films (media repo, branch agent/te/claude/showcase-voice) are re-narrated in Tobias's own cloned voice (VoxCPM2). Tobias decided on 2026-11-02: a player in each showcase tab AND a collected films page (docs/films.html, DES identity), Swedish and English with a language toggle, hosted on GitHub Pages with an outbound 'watch on YouTube' link (Tobias uploads; no YouTube embed, no third-party cookies). Publish only when the Swedish versions exist: the PR opens after that. Each committed video gets a MANIFEST.json bound to the media build and commit. Not in scope: re-narration itself (media repo), YouTube upload. Review: Codex.
